content: react-activity-calendar 3.2.1 (51K weekly downloads) is the best-maintained GitHub-style heatmap: native dark/light mode via colorScheme prop, theme customization, tooltips via renderBlock, localization. react-calendar-heatmap 1.10.0 (40K downloads) is older, requires manual dark mode CSS. react-contribution-calendar 2.0.4 is smaller ecosystem (1.4K downloads).
